name: WARNING: Texas Roadhouse 16 oz Ribeye Steak (Heavy Intermuscular Fat)
whyItWorks: Ribeye is famed for heavy marbling and thick bands of intermuscular fat (often 60g+ fat per steak). Heavy saturated animal fat delays gastric emptying and triggers rapid bile acid secretion, producing acute steatorrhea and diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Switch from ribeye to center-cut Sirloin or Filet Medallions, ordered plain without butter brush.
